item.title: Implementing Class-Level Properties with Getters and Setters in Python
item.description:
“Implementing Class-Level Properties with Getters and Setters in Python”

The inherent behavior of Python’s @property decorator targets instance attributes. When seeking a similar mechanism—a class property that exposes methods to get and set values that persist at the class level, callable via both the class and its instances—advanced techniques involving metaclasses or custom descriptor creation are often necessary. This exploration covers various robust solutions applicable across different Python environments.

Solution Approaches for Class Properties

Several expert solutions address the challenge of combining @classmethod functionality with @property behavior, especially considering version changes across Python releases.
